How to measure your foot
  1. Stand barefoot on a sheet of paper, on a flat floor.
  2. Hold a pen upright at your heel and another at your longest toe, and mark both points.
  3. Step off and measure the distance between the two marks.
  4. Repeat with the other foot and use the larger number.
  5. Measure in the evening, when feet are at their largest.

Sizes come from standard conversions and are rounded to the nearest half size.
